claim: The free Puzzle Press criss-cross (fill-in) generator built five grids at every grade from each of its 90 built-in themes, then solved every grid again from scratch: all 1,800 had exactly one fill, so the answer key is the only answer. A layout that could be filled two ways is thrown away, and at medium the middle grid took 31 layouts to find. In a phone browser with no sign-up it makes a 20-puzzle, 32-page criss-cross book for KDP.
notes: Real-time capture at 360x640 CSS px, 3x device pixels. Opens on the live criss-cross page's 'Measured on 1,800 grids' section and its table (layouts tried, middle / most: easy 5/87, medium 31/119, hard 19/115, expert 7/109), taps the page's own 'Make a book free' button into the tool, picks 'Hard — 16 words', sets 20 puzzles, downloads the interior PDF (the status line reads 'Done — 20 puzzles, 32 pages'), then holds Puzzle 1 (Animals, 16 words by length). Lead with a number: 1,800 of 1,800 with one fill. The grey ring marks each tap. The final hold keeps the puzzle still for the end card. 25.3 s.
